keywords.indexterm: power trunk resetting the power trunk

li.p: With the vehicle in POWER ON or DRIVE READY position, shift to P (Park).
Press the power trunk open/close button inside the trunk and the power trunk open/close button outside the vehicle simultaneously until a chime sounds.
With the vehicle in POWER ON or DRIVE READY position, shift to P (Park).
While Pressing the power trunk close inner button (1), press the power trunk open outer button (2) for more than 3 seconds. A chime will sound.
Power trunk close button inside the power trunk
Power trunk open button outside the vehicle
Press the power trunk open outer button (2). The trunk will open with a chime sound.
Wait until the trunk fully opens to complete resetting. If the trunk stops before it is fully open, resetting cannot be completed.
In some circumstances resetting the power trunk operation may need to be performed. Some instances where resetting the power trunk may be required include:
When the 12-volt battery is reinstalled after removal or replacement
When the related fuse is reinstalled after removal or replacement
If the power trunk does not operate properly after the above procedure, have it inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
